environment.description: Kubernetes pod running on AmazonLinux 2023 node with default container runtime (runc). Pod runs as non-root user (uid 1000) but with no AppArmor or SELinux profile applied. The container filesystem includes /etc/passwd readable by all users. CACHE_BASE_PATH is set to /var/cache/stream-processor/resources. No securityContext.seLinuxOptions or appArmorProfile annotation on the pod spec. Node SELinux is in permissive mode (setenforce 0 applied at boot via cloud-init for compatibility).
